notes: REQ-4.2: detailed settings. Clicking the 'Settings' item in the REQ-4.1 settings options menu opens the detailed settings dialog on the same page (no new route). The dialog markup lives in the served HTML (hidden via [hidden]) and shows configurable options with Save and Cancel actions. Option labels are copied verbatim from the requirement wording: 'Show new notes at the bottom' and 'Show checked items at the bottom' (both contain 'bottom' as asserted by the acceptance test), plus real 'Save' and 'Cancel' <button> elements. Each checkbox has a visible <label for=id> whose text is the option name. The REQ-4.1 settings menu items are plain <button> elements (no role=menuitem) so getByRole('button', {name:/^settings$/i}) resolves to the exact-text 'Settings' menu item, which sits before the gear icon in DOM order; clicking it opens the dialog. Settings values are per-page-load client state (the requirement only asks to display configurable options, not to persist them): Save stores the checkbox values in state.settings, closes the dialog and shows a confirmation; Cancel closes without applying. When 'Show new notes at the bottom' is saved as true, notes created during this page session are rendered at the end of the Others section (client-side ordering only); the default (unchecked) keeps the existing behavior, so parallel tests sharing one backend are unaffected. Escape or clicking the overlay closes the dialog (cancel).
